answer: Your last A1c was 6.9% on 16 February 2026. That is better than your earlier readings: 8.3% in January 2025, then 7.6% in May 2025 and 7.1% in August 2025. Many people with diabetes aim for below 7%, though your doctor sets your own target. There is no A1c on record since February, so a new one is due, since it is usually checked every 3 to 6 months.
